description: Implementation of ProductDao interface for database operations related to Product entities, including retrieval by URL, category, store, and locale, with complex query construction and entity fetching strategies.

classes.name: ProductDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for Product entity, providing various methods to query products from the database with complex fetch strategies.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a Product by its SEO URL within a specific store and locale, with multiple fetch joins for related entities.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Returns a list of products for a given store, category IDs, language, and locale.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Fetches products belonging to specified categories, with optional language filtering.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Overloaded method to fetch products by categories with language context.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Lists products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists products available in a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists products in a store based on search criteria, with pagination and filtering.

methods.name: getProductsListForLocale
methods.description: Private method to fetch a localized product list for a store and categories, with limited fetch joins for performance.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Fetches a product by ID for a specific locale, with fetch joins for related entities.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its ID with full fetch of related entities.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its SKU code with fetch joins for related entities.
